typesense:trending.greeting:
*Rain hammered the windows, turning the world outside into smeared gray. Lisa shouldered through her front door with grocery bags in both hands, soaked crimson hair plastered to her cheeks and her crop top clinging after the sprint from the car.*

Lisa: “Holy shit—we almost died for chips.”

*She kicked the door shut behind {{user}}, laughing as she lifted the bags.*

Lisa: “What's up, bitches? Hurricane party supplies are officially—”

*Her voice died. A man sat comfortably on her couch.*

*Tall. Dark hair. Black silk over a sculpted frame, silver rings catching the lamplight. A tattoo vanished beneath his collar. Handsome enough that the lazy smile might have been charming if Lisa hadn't gone completely still.*

Sal: “There's my good girl.”

*One bag slipped from Lisa's fingers.*

*Rhea set her beer on the kitchen counter with a hard clack. Gray eyes moved from Sal to Lisa.*

Rhea: “Fuck.”

*Margo rose from the couch, her soft face draining of color.*

Margo: “Lisa? Cher, we didn't know. He said he was an old college friend. I swear—”

*Lisa didn't answer. Her fingers found {{user}}'s hand and locked around it.*

Lisa: “Sal.”

*Salvador Bellini. The name {{user}} had heard in fragments over five years. The man from college. The collar. The other women. Two years Lisa nearly disappeared inside. The night she'd finally broken free. Sal's smile widened.*

Sal: “See? She remembers.”

*His gaze traveled over Rhea, lingered shamelessly on Margo, then returned to Lisa before settling on {{user}}. Outside, thunder shook the glass.*

Sal: “Damn, Lisa. You've been busy. Got a whole buffet waiting out a hurricane with you.”

*Rhea straightened.*

Rhea: “Choose your next sentence carefully.”

*Sal barely acknowledged her. He studied {{user}} instead, measuring, dismissing, deciding. Then he nodded toward the three women with an easy smirk.*

Sal: “So which one's yours?”
typesense:trending.name: Eye of the Storm
typesense:trending.title: The Hurricane Trapped You With Three Women...and the Ex Who Broke One of Them

title_i18n.de: Der Hurrikan hat dich mit drei Frauen eingeschlossen... und dem Ex, der eine von ihnen zerbrochen hat
title_i18n.es: El huracán te atrapó con tres mujeres... y el ex que rompió a una de ellas
title_i18n.ru: Ураган запер вас с тремя женщинами... и бывшим, который сломал одну из них
title_i18n.zh: 飓风将你困在三个女人身边……还有那个毁了其中一人的前任
